messages:
Priya Kumar: Heads up — SHEN Labs embedding / gen traffic is down ~62% WoW, token volume and calls both dipped. Billing spike shows fewer tokens, not errors. New POC in the contract is procurement (Sam O'Neill) — flagging as potential procurement/competitive review :flag-us:. Anyone sees a recent config or rollout that could explain?

Jules Park: thanks, saw lower request rate earlier this morning. No alerts from infra. I'll check recent canary rollouts and model variants. :eyes:

Ethan Liu: could be customer changed from streaming to batched offline jobs or switched endpoints. Quick SQL to verify user_id usage by endpoint:```sql
SELECT endpoint, count(*) AS calls, sum(tokens) AS tokens
FROM request_logs
WHERE customer_id='shenk' AND ts >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY endpoint;```
Run this and paste results?

Marco Diaz: FYI renewal window is 2026-06-01 — if procurement is involved early, this is a medium-risk signal. Also pinging RevOps offline to pull contract amendments / PO history. :spiral_calendar:

Priya Kumar: scheduled a 15-min intro + health check with Sam & their new procurement POC tomorrow 11:00am PT. Goal: surface SLOs, pricing ask, and confirm if they're running a competitor POC. I'll lead. Can Jules or Ethan join for technical questions? :calendar:

Sam O'Neill: procurement reached out this morning asking for detailed SSO/KMS and per-endpoint pricing breakdown. They're also running a small comparative bench with "NimbusAI" on ~10k sample requests this week — vendor said lower latency on short prompts. Not sure if that's the reason for traffic shift.

Jules Park: I can join the call. Pre-call action: I'll check if there were any model variant fallbacks that might increase latency and cause client-side throttling. Also will pull p95 latency per endpoint for last 7 days. :mag:

Ethan Liu: will prepare a short doc comparing our latency/cost profile vs common competitor patterns (quantization, smaller context windows). Also include suggestion to enable prefix KV caching for their batch job if they re-enable streaming.

Priya Kumar: immediate asks: (1) Jules — paste p95 numbers here before EOD, (2) Ethan — 1-page competitive notes and suggested mitigations before the call, (3) Marco — confirm contract renewal date & whether there's a price escalation clause. I'll draft a short slide for procurement covering SSO/KMS, SLAs, and migration support.

Marco Diaz: confirmed renewal 2026-06-01, no auto-escalation clause but there is a 30-day notice for pricing changes. I'll pull AMM for historical PO amounts.

ops-bot: Query run by Jules Park at 1799007801 — results uploaded: /internal/reports/shen-usage-1799007801.csv :page_facing_up:

Jules Park: quick take from the CSV — streaming endpoint 'redwood-chat-stream' calls down 68%, batch endpoint unchanged. p95 streaming latency stable ~120ms. No kernel fallback events. Hypothesis: client disabled streaming to avoid partials; maybe client-side SDK change.

Priya Kumar: good catch. On the call tomorrow let's ask their eng lead whether they toggled streaming or switched SDK. If they're benchmarking Nimbus, emphasize our dedicated support for throughput/cost tuning and the Optimize recommendations we can run on their traffic. Offer a short benchmark session with our Solutions team. :handshake:

Sam O'Neill: appreciate it. I'll surface the SDK change question and see whether the procurement-run benchmark is just a perf test or part of a vendor evaluation. I'll share procurement contact details in DM after this thread.

Priya Kumar: plan: run concurrent actions — tech triage (Jules/Ethan), procurement deck (Marco/Priya), call with procurement + eng tomorrow. Risk level: elevated but recoverable if we surface quick wins and offer a benchmark. Thanks team :thumbsup:
